description: Source code for a Lua UTF-8 manipulation library, implementing functions for UTF-8 decoding, length calculation, codepoint extraction, character creation, and iteration over UTF-8 strings.

methods.name: u_posrelat
methods.description: Translate a relative string position, handling negative indices.

methods.name: utf8_decode
methods.description: Decode a UTF-8 sequence into a codepoint, returning NULL if invalid.

methods.name: utflen
methods.description: Calculate the number of UTF-8 characters in a string within a specified range.

methods.name: codepoint
methods.description: Return codepoints for all characters in a specified range of a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: pushutfchar
methods.description: Push a UTF-8 character onto the Lua stack given a codepoint.

methods.name: byteoffset
methods.description: Calculate the byte offset of the n-th character from a position in a UTF-8 string.

methods.name: iter_aux
methods.description: Iterator helper for traversing UTF-8 codepoints with strictness option.

methods.name: iter_codes
methods.description: Create an iterator over UTF-8 codepoints in a string.

methods.name: luaopen_utf8
methods.description: Initialize the UTF-8 library in Lua.
